info.title: Together API
info.description:
Foundation endpoints: auth, profile, spaces, invites.

* All bodies are JSON. Unknown fields are rejected (`400 invalid_json`).
* Errors always look like `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}`. Clients branch on
  `code`; `message` is user-facing English copy.
* Authenticated endpoints take `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. On `401` with
  `invalid_access_token` call `/v1/auth/refresh` once and retry; on any other `401` sign the user out.
* A space you can't access answers `404 space_not_found` (never 403): other people's
  spaces, and especially their Personal space, don't exist as far as you know.
* Limits: any endpoint may answer `429 rate_limited` with `Retry-After` (600 requests/min per
  address; stricter on sign-in, sign-up, password reset, invite codes, avatar upload and event
  streams). Bodies over 21 MB get `413 body_too_large`. Creating beyond a space's caps (500 open
  grocery items, 20 lists, 1000 open tasks, 5000 notes) answers `409 limit_reached`. A list
  returns its newest 200 bought items; the notes list returns the newest 500 (search finds older).
  Receipt scans: 30 per person per day, `POST /receipts/scan` bodies up to 20 MB.
* Every response is `Cache-Control: no-store` (avatars: `private, max-age=300`). There is no CORS:
  the API is for the native app.

get.summary: Health (process up and database reachable) — deploy healthcheck
Liveness only (no dependency checks)

post.summary: Sign up with email + password
post.description: Creates the user, their Personal space and a session, and emails a verification link.

post.summary: Sign in with email + password
Sign in / up with Apple
post.description:
Send the `identityToken` from `ASAuthorizationAppleIDCredential` and the **raw** nonce whose SHA-256
you passed to Apple. Apple only shares the name on first sign-in: pass it as `display_name`.
Linking: a known Apple account signs in; otherwise a verified email matching a verified Together
account is linked to it; matching an *unverified* account returns `409 account_exists_unverified`;
otherwise a new user (+ Personal space) is created with `201`.

post.summary: Sign in / up with Google
post.description: Same as `/v1/auth/apple` with the Google `idToken`; the nonce (if any) is sent raw.

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token
post.description:
Every refresh token works once. Store the new pair atomically. Replaying an already used token
revokes the whole session (`refresh_token_reused`) — never retry a refresh with the old token.

post.summary: Sign out this device (revokes the session)
Sign out every device
Confirm email with the token from the link `{PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/verify-email?token=…`
Send a new verification email (invalidates the previous link)
Email a password reset link
post.description: Always `202`, whether or not the account exists. Link `{PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/reset-password?token=…`, valid 1 h.

post.summary: Set a new password from a reset token
post.description: Also marks the email verified, adds a password to Apple/Google-only accounts, and signs out every device.

get.summary: Current user

patch.summary: Update profile (onboarding "name" step, time zone, quiet hours)
patch.description: Send the device's IANA time zone on launch; reminders and quiet hours use it.

delete.description:
Deletes the user and everything Personal (tasks, notes, lists, avatar, devices). The user leaves their Shared
space: the partner keeps it and its content and becomes owner; a Shared space left empty is deleted. All
sessions end. If the account uses Sign in with Apple, run a fresh Apple sign-in first and send its
`authorizationCode`: the server revokes the Apple grant (Apple's rule) and stops with `502
apple_revoke_failed` if that fails, so you can retry.

post.summary: Link Apple or Google to the signed-in account

get.summary: My spaces (Personal first)

post.summary: Create the Shared space
post.description: A user can be in at most one Shared space. Only `kind=shared` can be created.

get.summary: One space

patch.summary: Rename a Shared space and/or set its shopping day (merge patch, null clears)

get.summary: Members (owner first)

post.summary: Leave a Shared space
post.description: If the owner leaves, the partner becomes owner. The last member leaving deletes the space.

post.summary: Create an invite (code TGT-XXXX + universal link)
post.description: One live invite per space — creating a new one revokes the previous one. Expires after 7 days.

get.summary: Invites of the space (latest 50)
Preview an invite before accepting

post.summary: Accept — join the Shared space
post.description: The inviter gets "Sam joined your Shared space" (push after their quiet hours) and the space stream emits `space.member_joined`.

post.summary: Decline — the code stops working

get.summary: Lists of the space (default first, with counters)
get.description: The MVP UI shows only the default list; the API supports many.

post.summary: Create a list

get.summary: A list with all its items (to buy first, newest first; then bought, most recent first)

patch.summary: Rename and/or make it the default list

is_default.description: Moves the default flag to this list

delete.summary: Delete a list and its items (purchase history stays)

get.summary: Items of a list

post.summary: Add an item
post.description:
Send `text` from the quick-add field ("2 oat milk" → name "Oat milk", qty "2"; same rule as the
client's parseQty), or explicit `name` / `qty` / `note`. Emits `item.added`.

patch.summary: Edit an item (empty qty/note clears it; list_id moves it within the space)

delete.summary: Remove an item (the client offers Undo by re-adding; no confirm)
delete.description: A tick not yet filed into a trip is removed from history too.

post.summary: Mark bought ("Sam bought this") — idempotent, records a purchase, emits `item.bought`

get.summary: History — trips of a month plus the month money line

post.summary: Finish a trip — file ticks not yet in a trip (all, or `purchase_ids`)

get.summary: One trip with its lines

delete.description:
Removes the trip from History with its lines (a receipt added twice, say), so they no longer count towards
month totals or suggestions. List items are left as they are. Emits `trip.deleted` with `removed_id`.

post.summary: Review a receipt (read-only)
post.description:
For lines you already have as text (`POST /receipts/scan` reads photos). The server matches them against open items and
ticks of the last 24 h not yet in a trip. `matched` → will be marked bought, `extra` → history only,
`unclear` → unreadable or ambiguous, with `did_you_mean` when there is a plausible item.
Nothing changes until `POST /receipts`.

post.summary: Scan a receipt from 1–5 photos (read-only review)
post.description:
Upload 1–5 photos of ONE receipt as `multipart/form-data`, each in an `image` part, top to bottom
(a long receipt photographed in parts; consecutive parts may overlap). Different receipts are
separate scans. JPEG, PNG or HEIC; at most 8 MB and 50 MP per photo, 20 MB in all.

The server re-encodes each photo (orientation applied, long edge ≤ 2576 px, ≤ 3.75 MP, EXIF/GPS
removed) and sends them in one request to the Claude API, which returns merchant, date, total and
the product lines (lines repeated in an overlap come back once; "rabat"/"opust" lines are applied
to the product above; weighed goods keep their weight). The lines are then reviewed exactly like
`POST /receipts/match`: `matched` / `extra` / `unclear` with `did_you_mean`. A line the recognizer
is unsure about (`unclear: true`) is never `matched`; its candidate is offered as `did_you_mean`.

**Nothing is saved and nothing is marked bought.** Send the reviewed lines (`name`, `qty`,
`price_grosze`, plus `item_id` / `purchase_id`) to `POST /receipts` to apply them.
`total_matches: false` means the lines don't add up to the printed total — ask the person to
check the prices.

**Privacy:** the photos are processed in memory and never stored or logged; neither is the
receipt text. They are sent to Anthropic (Claude API) for recognition only.

Limits: 30 scans per person per day (a scan counts once, whatever the number of photos; rejected
uploads don't count) → `429 rate_limited` with `Retry-After`. A scan takes about 10–40 s; use a
long client timeout (≥ 100 s).

image.description: Repeat the `image` part for each photo, in order (top of the receipt first).

200.description: The recognized receipt, reviewed against the list

413.description: `image_too_large` — over 8 MB / 50 MP per photo or 20 MB in all

422.description: `too_many_images` (more than 5), `bad_image` (can't be decoded), `not_a_receipt`, `receipt_unreadable` (nothing legible — retake a sharper, flatter photo), `receipt_too_long` (split it into more photos)

503.description: `receipt_scan_unavailable` — the recognizer is overloaded or timed out (after retries); try again after `Retry-After`. `receipt_scan_disabled` — scanning isn't configured on this server.

post.summary: Confirm a reviewed receipt ("Mark 5 as bought")
post.description:
Send only the included lines. `item_id` marks that open item bought via receipt; `purchase_id` files
an existing tick; neither = extra (history only). Everything lands in one trip with `via_receipt`.
`total_grosze` defaults to the sum of line prices when all lines have one.

201.description: Trip and the items now bought

get.summary: What you usually buy and is due now (at most 4, never added automatically)

post.summary: "Not this week" — hide a suggestion for both partners
Add (one) or Add all — puts suggestions on a list with their usual quantity

get.summary: Realtime changes of the space from every module (Server-Sent Events)
get.description:
`text/event-stream`. Each event: `event: <type>`, `id`, `data: <GroceryEvent | TaskEvent JSON>`. Grocery types:
list.created, list.updated, list.deleted, item.added, item.updated, item.bought, item.unbought,
item.removed, trip.created, trip.deleted. Task types: task.created, task.updated, task.completed, task.reopened,
task.deleted. Note types: note.created, note.updated, note.deleted, note.restored, note.moved_out, note.moved_in.
Space: space.member_joined ("Sam joined your Shared space"). `actor_id` says who did it ("Sam bought this", "Sam did this"). A `: ping` comment
comes every 25 s. On disconnect, reconnect (the server suggests `retry: 3000`) and refetch the list:
events are not replayed.

get.summary: Tasks — active (by due date, undated last) or done (latest 100)

post.summary: Create a task (only the title is required)
post.description:
In a Personal space the task is always the owner's (`assignee_id` may be omitted). In Shared it is a member
or nobody ("Anyone"). Assigning a partner queues an "Alex asked you to" push, delivered after their quiet hours.
Emits `task.created`.

get.summary: One task

patch.summary: Edit a task (JSON merge patch — absent = unchanged, null = clear)
patch.description:
Moving the due date moves a pending reminder by the same number of days (same wall-clock time, quiet hours
re-applied). A new assignee becomes the reminder's recipient; `assignee_id: null` ("Anyone") removes the
reminder. There is never more than one reminder per task. Emits `task.updated`.

delete.summary: Delete a task and its reminder

post.summary: Complete ("Sam did this")
post.description:
One-off task: done, its pending reminder is cancelled. Repeating task: stays open and its due date rolls to the
next occurrence after today (weekly +7 days; monthly keeps the start day, clamped to the month length:
31 Jan → 28 Feb → 31 Mar), and the reminder rolls with it. `rolled` tells which. Idempotent. Emits `task.completed`.

post.summary: Undo a completion (reopens, or rolls a repeating task back; restores the reminder)

put.summary: Turn on or reschedule the reminder

get.summary: My registered devices

post.summary: Register (or refresh) this phone's APNs token
post.description: Call on every launch after `registerForRemoteNotifications`. A token moves to the account that registers it last.

get.summary: Notes of the space, most recently updated first — or search with `q`

post.summary: Create a note in this space (plain text + optional checklist)

get.summary: One note with its checklist; `ETag` is its version

patch.summary: Edit title/body — requires `If-Match` with the version you edited
patch.description:
Optimistic concurrency: if the partner saved in between, the answer is `409 version_conflict` with the note as
it is now (`note`) and its `ETag`; merge and retry. Checklist changes never conflict with text edits.

delete.summary: Delete (soft) — restorable for 1 hour, then purged

post.summary: Undo a delete
Move a Personal note to Shared ("Move to Shared", after the ConfirmSheet) — or Undo that move
Add a checklist line (at the end, or at `position`)

patch.summary: Tick, rename or reorder one line (no If-Match needed)

get.summary: Everything the Home screen shows for ONE space, in one call
get.description:
Three short sections (no statistics): up to 3 tasks that need attention (overdue → due today → assigned to
you → by date; "today" is in the caller's time zone), the default grocery list (open count + newest 3 items +
suggestion names for the teaser) and the 3 most recently updated notes. `show_invite` is true in a Shared
space with nobody else in it. Every section comes from this space only: a Shared Home never contains
anything Personal.

get.summary: My settings

patch.description:
`suggestions_enabled: false` empties `/suggestions` and the Home teaser for you (your partner keeps theirs).
A notification kind turned off is never pushed — also when it was already queued.

put.summary: Upload my avatar (raw JPEG or PNG body, ≤ 10 MB)
put.description:
The server decodes the picture, crops a centered square and re-encodes JPEG at 512 and 128 px — EXIF and
GPS never survive. HEIC isn't accepted: send `UIImage.jpegData`. The previous avatar is deleted.

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: Cache-busting version from the avatar URL

get.summary: Someone's avatar — only for themselves and people sharing a space with them
get.description: Authenticated, `Cache-Control private, max-age=300`, ETag/If-None-Match. Anyone else gets 404, as for a person with no avatar. Use the `url` from `/v1/me` or the members list.

get.summary: Universal links for the iOS app
get.description:
Associates `/invite/*`, `/verify-email*` and `/reset-password*` with the app ids in `APPLE_APP_IDS`
(`TEAMID.bundle.id`), plus `webcredentials` for password AutoFill. Served as JSON at 200 without a
redirect, as iOS requires. 404 when `APPLE_APP_IDS` is empty.

get.summary: Stylesheet of the link pages (built from the design tokens)
Confirm-email page (for people without the app)
get.description:
The link in the verification email. Opening it changes nothing (link scanners fetch URLs): the page
shows a "Confirm email" button that POSTs the token. With the app installed, iOS opens the link in
the app instead, which calls `POST /v1/auth/email/verify`.

post.summary: Confirm the email (form post from the page)
post.description: Needs the page's CSRF cookie and field and a same-origin `Origin`. Rate-limited like the JSON endpoint.

get.summary: Choose-a-new-password page (for people without the app)
get.description:
The link in the reset email: a form for the new password (twice). Opening it doesn't use the token.
With the app installed, iOS opens the link in the app, which calls `POST /v1/auth/password/reset`.

post.summary: Set the new password (form post from the page)
post.description: Same password rules as the API (8–256 characters); signs out every device. CSRF-protected and rate-limited.

422.description: Passwords differ or too short (the form again

get.summary: Invite page (for people without the app)
get.description:
The universal link in an invite (`InviteDTO.link`). Explains how to join and shows the code, with an
App Store button when `APP_STORE_URL` is set. It never looks the code up (no way to test codes).

ListID.name: listID
ListID.description: A list id, or `default` for the space's default list

nonce.description: Raw nonce generated by the client for this sign-in (required: binds the token to it, so a leaked ID token can't be replayed). Apple: pass SHA-256(nonce) to Apple, send the raw one here.

NoteWithETag.description: Note (the ETag header carries its version)

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next attempt is allowed

SpaceNotFound.description: `space_not_found` — doesn't exist or you may not see it

QuietHours.description: Reminders falling inside are delivered at `end`. start == end turns quiet hours off.

is_new_user.description: true → show onboarding (name → invite or solo)

shopping_day.description: Usual shopping weekday, 0 = Sunday; suggestions are timed for it

total_grosze.description: PLN in grosze; null = no receipt / no total

lines.description: Only in GET /trips/{tripID} and responses that create a trip

reason.example: Usually every week · last bought 8 days ago

purchase_id.description: Set when the item is already ticked

purchased_on.description: Sale date printed on the receipt

total_grosze.description: "SUMA PLN" — send it as `total_grosze` to POST /receipts

total_matches.description: false = lines don't add up to the total (check prices); null = no total

raw.description: The line as printed (show it under the clean `name`)

discount_grosze.description: "rabat"/"opust" applied to this line (price_grosze = line − discount)

unclear.description: The recognizer isn't sure — the person must check this line

time.description: Wall-clock time in the task's time_zone; null = all day

Repeat.description: Needs a due date. Values match the client's RepeatRule.

ReminderIn.description: Either an exact time or the design's default ("Morning of · 9:00" with a date, "Tomorrow · 9:00" without).

shifted_from.description: The time asked for, when it fell into the recipient's quiet hours and was moved to their end (8:00)

title.description: May be empty — show the first line of the body

preview.description: NoteRow preview: the body, or the checklist as "Passport, Chargers"

version.description: Send back as If-Match when editing title/body

total.description: Open tasks in the space ("5 to do")

suggestions.description: Names for "3 things you usually buy — review"

task_assigned.description: "Alex asked you to" when a partner assigns a task

grocery_reminder.description: Stored for the planned shopping-day reminder; nothing sends it yet

url.description: Relative to the API; send the bearer token
